title: interleave_evenly raises IndexError when given no iterables
spec:
This is the more-itertools library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 run_tests.py`.

Calling `interleave_evenly` with an empty list of iterables crashes.

```python
import more_itertools as mi
list(mi.interleave_evenly([]))
list(mi.interleave_evenly([], lengths=[]))
```

EXPECTED: both return `[]` (nothing to interleave, so an empty result, like `interleave` and `interleave_longest` give for no input).

ACTUAL: both raise `IndexError: list index out of range`.

Non-empty inputs already work and must keep working.
acceptance: Existing interleave_evenly behavior for non-empty inputs is unchanged
